RE A25 / 113922Z. With the original 31 certified wins and an ordinary stock defender, the stock / existing table-free corner / exact-root attackers mated on 14/31, 31/31, 31/31 at 10+0.1. At 1+0.1 the counts were 15/31, 31/31, 31/31. The KBN breakdown was 8/25,25/25,25/25 at the long bank and 9/25,25/25,25/25 at the short. Every arm won all six bishop-pair controls at each bank. Zero flags in any arm. At 10+0.1, 17 new mates and zero lost correspond to +0.20752 percentage points [0.10986,0.31738] of the original 8,192 source IDs; at 1+0.1 the figures were +16 and +0.19531 points [0.10986,0.29297]. Both gates passed, including matching every exact-won KBN on these two actual-clock panels. This matches the separate 18-position real-clock finding. Against an exact delaying defender the original panel still contains real table-free misses at 250k and 1M. We should compare both options under the future promoted-net trigger.

We audited every real bank, selected exact move, rule ending and full native move history across 186 games/9,571 turns. The six early contended cells were discarded before looking at their outcomes; all reported games are from the complete reserved-core replay. Each root kept all arms and banks on its assigned core (120718Z). The native stock long-bank misses were 15 fifty-move draws and two threefold repetitions; short-bank misses were 16 fifty-move draws. A second games.csv audit verified all per-ID differences and exact finite empirical resampling quantiles agreed with the 10,000 registered bootstrap draws. Exact compare, inequalities, clocks, rotating order and tool invocation as in 113922Z/111749Z. Raw games/timing below, including full per-move bank charges and actual endfen. The output is observed conversion at the prescribed incoming clocks. No overall Elo inference.
